evals.prompt: The code-atlas server is set up on evals/testdata/notes-app. Map the whole repo into it so an auditor can use it later.
evals.expected_output: A complete atlas of the notes app: every callable symbol mapped, guessed edges resolved, a rollup for app/ and a flow per route, followed by a short coverage and risk report.
assertions: get_macro_atlas reports 20/20 callable symbols mapped, 0 stale, 0 unverified heuristic edges
NoteRepo.search has a strict contract with trust_boundary true and risk_score >= 8, and its edge to Database.query has data_taint_propagated
NoteService.get_note's contract records the missing ownership check (an IDOR)
the edge NoteService::get_note -> UserRepo::find and current_user -> NoteRepo::find are LLM_PRUNED
the edge Database::query -> Database::execute is LLM_PRUNED (self.conn.execute is sqlite3)
sign or verify_token records the hard-coded SECRET
a module rollup exists for app and flows exist for both /search and /notes/<id>
query_audit_surface TRUST_BOUNDARY_TO_SINK_PATHS returns a path from search to Database.query
the final message reports coverage and the top risks as hypotheses, not confirmed bugs

no symbol outside app/auth.py is submitted
verify_token's contract mentions the non-constant-time comparison or the ValueError on malformed tokens
